programme.title: Unearth S1 - "The Next Great Extinction Event"
programme.desc: Experts explain our history and evolution of Earth over its 4 billion year history and take us through to the current emergency where humans may be one of the species to become extinct.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "A.I. The Code For Consiousness?"
programme.desc: Hollywood has made us rather fearful of Artificial Intelligence, or A.I. But as we shall see, A.I. and its dance partner robotics might not be the nemesis we should fear; at least, not if we get them right.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "Germ Warefare"
programme.desc: A new enemy is emerging. This new enemy is the natural world itself, a microscopic realm of bacteria. And not just any bacteria, but the so-called super-bugs. We'll look at the emerging threats and what scientists are doing to counter them.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into the Skies"
programme.desc: Growth in air transportation is set to soar, carrying over 10 billion passengers every year by 2050. To cope requires us to radically rethink aircraft design. Join us as we look into the world's most innovative research and development labs.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into Space"
programme.desc: The most innovative area of human motion lies not on Earth, but with the exploration of space. Meet the private space entrepreneurs jostling to offer the tantalizing prospect of cheap, frequent travel beyond the atmosphere into Earth orbit.

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Speedskating"
programme.desc: Speed skater Beorn Nijenhuis and presenter Julien Kang visit laboratories to ask how does technology help to make the difference between silver and gold?

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Snowboarding"
programme.desc: How do innovators and athletes work together to beat the competition on the slope and the half pipe?

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: Angry Planet S1 - "African Hellhole"
programme.desc: Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the bubbling lake of molten lava and investigates the risk the dangerous volcano poses to both the people of city of Goma and the Mountain Gorillas who live on the nearby jungle slopes.

programme.title: Angry Planet S1 - "Fire and Water"
programme.desc: Host/adventurer George Kourounis follows the fabled route of the Klondike Gold Rush sourdoughs through the bawdy town of Skagway, Alaska, paddling the white water rivers and the White Horse Rapids into the Yukon.

programme.title: Angry Planet S1 - "The Winds of Autumn"
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Research in Remote Locations"
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit a few remote areas to see how research and restoration is conducted.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Science Communicators"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll meet a few different science communicators

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "The Ocean’s Apex"
programme.desc: In this episode, we observe two of the ocean’s apex predators in the wild.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Just Like Downtown"
programme.desc: Dave deals with a messy train, J.P. takes down a tree, Regional Crane lifts a huge wall, and Maxum Crane moves a couch to a high-rise.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programme.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programme.desc: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programme.desc: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.
